title.narrative: Fortalecimiento de la Producción Orgánica y Comercialización de Café

description.narrative: The Federation of Cooperatives of Coffee Producers of Guatemala (FECCEG) is a second-level organization that brings together 12 cooperatives and associations of small coffee producers in 9 departments of the country. Their work focuses on promoting organic coffee production and fair trade as a way to improve the living conditions of rural families, with an emphasis on the inclusion of women and youth. The project presented for the period 2025-2028, seeks to improve the production, quality and competitiveness of organic coffee produced by the organizations. The initiative will directly benefit 1,050 people and indirectly about 12,000 linked to member organizations. The project aims to strengthen the production and marketing of high-quality organic coffee, through the development of capacities in management, certification, added value and access to differentiated markets. Their actions will promote better family incomes, greater economic resilience and sustainable agricultural practices. It will also promote the active participation and empowerment of women and young people in the coffee value chain, and will strengthen FECCEG's institutionality as a representative platform that contributes to the economic, social and environmental development of its base organizations.
